title: Eyk Timer
description:
A small Windows timer. Open, type 1–999 minutes, press Enter. The window disappears while your countdown keeps running. When time is up, an audible and visible alarm brings you back. Press Enter to acknowledge.

Up to ten independent timers. Reopen using the displayed keyboard shortcut or the hourglass in the notification area. Hover to see the next countdown.

No accounts, ads or analytics. No presets or settings dialog. Timers last for the current session. An overdue alarm is delivered when your computer wakes from sleep.
features: Global shortcut and hourglass in the notification area
systemRequirements: Windows 10 version 2004 or newer, x64, Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Tested on Windows 11 x64.
